key_fields.sql: select z.locationid, z.borough, z.zone, count(t.pulocationid) as cash_trips from ops.zones z left join lake.trips t on t.pulocationid = z.locationid and t.payment_type = 2 group by z.locationid, z.borough, z.zone order by z.locationid
key_fields.claim: A filter on the joined side sits in the ON clause of a LEFT JOIN; the join dominates the cost. (matched: left join lake.trips t on … and t.payment_type = 2)

value.sql: SELECT z.LocationID, z.Borough, z.Zone, COALESCE(t.cnt, 0) AS cash_trips FROM ops.zones z LEFT JOIN (SELECT PULocationID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM lake.trips WHERE payment_type = 2 GROUP BY PULocationID) t ON t.PULocationID = z.LocationID ORDER BY z.LocationID
value.change_summary: Pre-aggregate filtered trips by PULocationID to reduce join input from ~99K rows to at most 243 groups, eliminating per-row cast overhead in the hash join.
value.risk_notes: Relies on PULocationID and payment_type having compatible types with LocationID; if implicit cast semantics differ, counts could change for edge values.
